featured_reviews.name: Rohit Maurya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed with the Treatment Approach

I recently had a deeply disappointing experience at this hospital concerning my mother's health. She was admitted for one day due to a gastric issue. All her reports came back normal, and she was feeling better the next day. Despite this, the doctor insisted on keeping her admitted for an additional three days—without providing a clear medical justification.

When we asked for an explanation, we were told vaguely that she needed antibiotics and "the treatment wasn't complete." It felt more like an excuse to prolong the stay and increase the charges, rather than a decision based on genuine medical necessity.

What’s worse, when I questioned this, the doctor reacted defensively, citing her MBBS degree etc. She then asked me and my father to leave the consultation room, which was both rude and unprofessional.

This experience has left us with serious concerns about the hospital's intentions and patient care ethics. I urge others to seek a second opinion and prioritize preventive healthcare—eat well, stay active, and consult transparent medical professionals who truly have the patient’s best interest at heart.

featured_reviews.name: Cianna Hendricks
featured_reviews.review_text: I am extremely grateful to Raut Hospital and especially to Dr. Rajendra Pingale for the exceptional care and support I received over the years. I first consulted Dr. Pingale in 2024 for a second opinion after my miscarriage and D&C procedure. From the very first visit, he handled my case with great sensitivity, patience, and professionalism, which gave me immense confidence and emotional strength. Later, when I conceived again, Dr. Pingale guided me at every appointment with the utmost care, clarity, and encouragement. Because of his expert guidance, I was able to have a safe pregnancy and successfully deliver in 2025. I will always be thankful for his constant support throughout this journey. Recently, I also underwent gallbladder surgery under his care, and once again, the treatment was excellent. The surgery and recovery process were smooth, and I felt well looked after at every stage. The hospital staff are equally kind, cooperative, and attentive, making the overall experience very comforting. I highly recommend Dr. Rajendra Pingale and Raut Hospital to anyone seeking compassionate, skilled, and trustworthy medical care.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am incredibly grateful to have had Dr. Sonali Gaidhankar as my gynecologist throughout my pregnancy and delivery. From the very beginning, she made me feel safe, heard, and genuinely cared for her calm guidance, patience, and expertise gave me so much confidence during every step of my journey.

During my delivery, her reassuring presence and compassionate support made one of the most important days of my life truly beautiful. I couldn’t have asked for a better doctor to be by aamy side.

Due to an emergency, I was shifted to another multi-speciality Hospital. At that time, I was scared, but Dr. Sonali’s constant support never left me. She visited KK Hospital from morning till night, and we were shocked—in the best way—to see her come again at 1:30 am just to check on me. She continuously followed up with the hospital staff and even came the next morning at 6 am. She visited 4–5 times and ultimately helped me deliver normally.

I was 100% sure my delivery would be a C-
section, but Dr. Sonali made a normal delivery possible. If she hadn’t been there, I know the other doctors would not have waited and would have gone ahead with a C-section. Dr. Sonali is truly more than just a doctor. We don’t have words to express how grateful we are for her.

Doctor and and their staff is very supportive.

Thank you, Dr. Sonali, for your exceptional care—you’ve made a lifelong impact on me and my family. You will always have a special place in our hearts.

I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, kind, and dedicated gynaecologist.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share my experience for expecting mothers who are looking for a good doctor rather than a fancy hospital.

I found Dr. Sonnekar Nursing home  through a reference when I was about two months pregnant. From the first consultation, she was very warm, calm, and easy to talk to. Throughout my pregnancy, she guided me properly and only suggested necessary scans instead of unnecessary tests.

During one of my later check-ups, the baby's head position was not suitable for normal delivery, so the doctor recommended a C-section. I was very scared at first, but she explained everything patiently and gave me confidence that the procedure would be safe.

The nursing staff prepared me well before the surgery and kept talking to me during the procedure so I felt comfortable. Within about 40 minutes, I was back in my room with my baby girl in my arms. It was a very special and emotional moment when the doctor brought my newborn to me.

The nurses took very good care of both me and my baby during the hospital stay. They also taught me important things like breastfeeding, swaddling the baby, preparing formula milk, and basic newborn care. The cleanliness of the hospital was also very good.

This may not be a fancy hospital, but if you want a skilled, caring doctor and supportive staff for pregnancy and delivery, I would definitely recommend Dr Shilpa Sonnekar 👍🤗.
